blocks.text: The forty Singhs are described fighting in succession and in close waves, each taking up the struggle even as the Guru watches from a rise beyond the immediate crush. (24–27)
The attackers misread the field, overestimating Sikh numbers because of the fierceness and mobility of the defense, while bodies pile up and the contest becomes hand-to-hand. (28–29)
At the end of each surge the enemy strips the fallen, so the page juxtaposes the forty Singhs' courage with the ugly scavenging of the victors. (30–31)
